t.zh: 定语从句里也会有自己的修饰成分；主干的主语和宾语都可以带着一个从句。
t.en: A relative clause can have modifiers of its own, and both the subject and the object may carry a clause.

title.zh: The approach that we describe in Section 4 reduces the memory that the attention layer requires.
title.en: The approach that we describe in Section 4 reduces the memory that the attention layer requires.

body.zh: 主干 The approach reduces the memory。主语带着 that we describe in Section 4（里面 in Section 4 挂在 describe 上），宾语带着 that the attention layer requires。我们在第 4 节介绍的方法减少了注意力层所需的内存。
body.en: The skeleton is The approach reduces the memory. The subject carries that we describe in Section 4 (with in Section 4 on describe), the object that the attention layer requires.

note.zh: 从句里的修饰成分挂在从句里的词上，先折。
note.en: A modifier inside a clause hangs on a word inside it; fold it first.

brief.zh: 标出主干，把修饰成分一层层折起来。
brief.en: Mark the skeleton, folding the modifiers layer by layer.

hint.zh: in Section 4 说明的是从句里的哪个词？
hint.en: Which word inside the clause does in Section 4 tell about?

tasks.sentence: The approach that we describe in Section 4 reduces the memory that the attention layer requires.
